design.quote: This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated the impact of vitamin D supplementation on sepsis outcomes

population.quote: Eligible studies enrolled patients with sepsis who received vitamin D supplementation and reported mortality outcomes

sample_size.quote: Five studies encompassing 42,915 patients met the inclusion criteria

intervention.quote: patients with sepsis who received vitamin D supplementation

primary_findings.quote: vitamin D supplementation was may associated with reduction in 28-day mortality (OR: 0.59, 95 % CI: 0.51-0.69, P < 0.0001)

limitations_stated.value: the overall quality of evidence was rated low due to inconsistency and imprecision
limitations_stated.quote: the overall quality of evidence was rated low due to inconsistency and imprecision

limitations_stated.value: the low certainty of evidence highlights the need for well-designed, large-scale randomized controlled trials to confirm these findings
limitations_stated.quote: the low certainty of evidence highlights the need for well-designed, large-scale randomized controlled trials to confirm these findings and guide clinical practice
